scope: Read-only follow-up review of the narrowly added checkpoint-kind and candidate-run path guards. No CUDA context, GPU training, or CPU integration gate was started or interrupted by this review.

verdict.summary: The prior QAT-RUNNER-004 manual-resume finding is closed in the current source. Formal execution remains restricted by procedure to execute(); no authentication nonce was added or requested.

evidence.check: validate_state requires candidate to be exactly expected_candidate and formal_acceptance to be exactly false.
restore passes the expected candidate kind through before loading model, optimizer, or RNG state.
The CPU continuity gate uses the default expected_candidate=false for its non-candidate checkpoint.
A worker resume must resolve to a file directly under RUN and must validate as candidate=true. The CPU integration checkpoint is therefore rejected both by path and checkpoint kind.
Completion validation requires every saved update checkpoint to validate as candidate=true.

normalization_test.coverage: Compares microbatch=2 accumulation against one complete 22-sample YOLOXLoss update for reported loss, pre-clip gradient norm, and post-SGD parameters, with varying zero/one/two-box targets.
normalization_test.note: No durable test log was present in the reviewed report directory at supplement time; this supplement records the coordinator-reported pass and independently confirms the test logic and current source.

source_change.expected_difference: Adds expected_candidate/formal_acceptance validation, candidate-run parent-path enforcement, and updated validate_state call sites.

remaining_boundary.detail: The worker GO handshake is not cryptographically authenticated. The authorized formal path is still execute() through run_protected(); direct worker invocation remains procedurally forbidden. This was not expanded because the coordinator explicitly kept the formal run on execute() and requested no nonce architecture.
